title: Desktop Sync
scanCtaHint: In the desktop app: Settings → Sync → Pair a device.
setupRowPairedPending: Not paired yet — scan the QR code above
setupJoinWaitingHint: Waiting for your desktop to turn on cloud sync — it stores the group key in your account, then this finishes by itself.
setupJoinIdle: Starts when you pair with your desktop
pendingApprovalHint: Waiting for approval on {{peer}}… Approve this device in the desktop app to finish pairing.
rejectedHint: The desktop refused the pairing — often a version mismatch. Update Soulbits Engine on both devices, then connect again.
pendingWritesWarning: {{count}} buffered change(s) have not reached the desktop yet. They stay on this device and sync on reconnect.
authNeededBanner: Refreshing your cloud session — cloud sync needs a fresh sign-in token.
authSignInExpiredBanner: Cloud sign-in expired — sign in again to resume cloud sync.
authRecoveryFailedBanner: Couldn't refresh your cloud sign-in automatically. Cloud sync stays paused — sign in again if this keeps happening.
quotaExceededBanner: Cloud sync is paused — your plan's sync quota is full. Free up space in the portal to resume.
narrationPausedBanner: Narration paused — the authority lease expired, so this device stopped narrating to avoid duplicate replies. It resumes automatically when the lease is renewed.
rotationBanner: A key rotation was requested for this account. Reset the sync key to continue syncing.
stateSub_idle: Sync is enabled and waiting to connect.
stateSub_pending_approval: Waiting for approval on the desktop…
stateSub_rejected: The pairing was refused — it may be running an older Soulbits Engine build.
stateSub_promoted: This device now leads; the other device buffers changes.
stateSub_quota_exceeded: Your plan's cloud sync quota is full.
stateSub_awaiting_key: Your desktop needs to turn on cloud sync once.
pairingHint: Prefer scanning the QR above; paste a pairing code here only when scanning isn't possible.
pairingCodeHint: The code expires a few minutes after it is shown — mint a fresh one if pairing fails.
pairingSignedOut: Sign in to your SoulbitsCloud account first.
pairingAccountMismatch: This pairing code was created for a different account.
scanInstruction: Point the camera at the QR code shown in the Soulbits Cloud portal.
scanPermissionMessage: Allow camera access to scan the pairing QR code, or paste the pairing code below instead.
transportLanHint: Connect directly to a desktop engine on your local network.
transportCloudHint: Sync through the Soulbits Cloud relay — works across networks, end-to-end encrypted.
advancedHint: Enter the desktop address and security mode by hand instead of scanning.
peerAddressHint: host:port of the desktop engine's event server (e.g. 192.168.1.10:28080).
peerWssAddressHint: Leave empty to reuse the address above or the port the desktop advertises.
securityHintSecure: Verified TLS — the desktop's certificate is checked against the system trust store.
securityHintInsecureSsl: Accepts a self-signed desktop certificate. Use only on a trusted LAN.
securityHintUnencrypted: Plaintext over the LAN. Use only on a fully trusted network.
relayUrlHint: The Soulbits Cloud relay endpoint. Usually filled in from the pairing code.
deviceIdHint: This device's identifier in the sync group.
datasetIdHint: The shared dataset id for this sync group (from the relay / pairing).
accountSignedOutHint: Sign in to your SoulbitsCloud account to use cloud sync.
deviceNamePlaceholder: Shown in the desktop approval prompt
relayOverflow: Relay buffer overflow — this device will re-baseline on the next connection.
relayRejected: {{count}} frame(s) rejected by the replay guard.
groupHelp_uninitialized: Start cloud sync on this device to create the encrypted sync group and store its key in your account.
groupHelp_member: This device holds the sync-group key. Reset it if a device was lost or revoked — other devices re-sync on their next connection.
groupHelp_key_pending: Waiting for the group key. On another device, start cloud sync to escrow the key, then finish joining here.
startCloudSyncButton: Start a new sync group (this device leads)
startCloudSyncDone: Cloud sync started — the group key is stored in your account.
resetKeyMessage: A new key is minted and stored in your account. Other devices re-sync from scratch on their next connection, and old encrypted frames become unreadable.
resetKeyDone: Sync key reset. Other devices re-sync on their next connection.
yieldMessage: Write authority will be transferred to the desktop. This device stops leading and buffers changes until the desktop leads.
disablePendingWrites: {{count}} buffered change(s) have not reached the desktop yet. Disabling keeps them on this device, but they will not sync until you re-enable desktop sync.
lanUnavailableStore: This connection type isn't available in this version
lanConfirmNote: Showing this code authorized this device once. The pairing secret is single-use.
lanPairingSuccess: Paired with {{name}} — connecting over your local network…
enrollMismatchMessage: This desktop is signed in as «{{account}}», which isn't your account. Pairing continues, but sign-in sharing is skipped.
footer: Desktop sync keeps this device's characters, messages and settings in step with a desktop engine — over your local network or through the Soulbits Cloud relay.
